finalists.label: Posterior Scleritis
finalists.why: It has specific findings such as choroidal detachments and mild posterior scleral enhancement that are not shared with its rivals.

finalists.label: Retinal Detachment
finalists.why: It is directly mentioned in the vignette with specific details like overlying retinal detachment with shifting subretinal fluid and no retinal breaks.

finalists.label: Central Serous Chorioretinopathy
finalists.why: It explains the fluorescein angiography findings and the nature of the retinal detachment, despite the presence of some inflammatory signs.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of choroidal detachments and mild posterior scleral enhancement specifically supports Posterior Scleritis over the other finalists.
